stem: A team proposes changing irrigation frequency, pulse volume and nutrient concentration at the same time to fix a poorly defined root-zone problem. What is the strongest objection?
choices: Multiple simultaneous changes make it harder to identify which factor affected the response
All three variables are always harmless
Nutrient concentration has no relationship to root-zone chemistry
rationale: Controlled troubleshooting should reduce uncertainty; simultaneous major changes confound interpretation of cause and response.
